race.description: Picklebet Get Your Pickle On Hcp (C2)
race.comment: CAISHEN (3) has the strongest recent profile, with a close Class 1 second to King Emperor two starts back and a sound fourth in a BM62 at Sunshine Coast when beaten just over three lengths. He is race fit, gets a 1.5kg claim and has been consistent enough this campaign to be the one to beat. OVEROPTOMYSTIC (4) brings upside after winning a Mdn at Gold Coast Poly by four and a half lengths as an odds-on favourite, though this is a sharper Class 2 test. CANADIAN FLING (5) is better than her Ipswich fifth suggests after being checked near the 400m, and her Gold Coast BM60 win the run prior keeps her right in calculations. BOLE LE (7) has been holding form, with consecutive seconds at Toowoomba and Ipswich, and his record around 1500m gives him another genuine winning chance.
